2126189347481538755.en_summary: Industry channel check with Yuanjie Semiconductor: not supplying Eoptolink due to insufficient own CW laser capacity (positive for merchant laser players); $AXTI InP substrate prices rose several percentage points in Q4 2026; ~80% of Sumitomo capacity locked by InnoLight; 300-400mW lasers primarily supplied to $NVDA for NPO architecture as core supplier amid $LITE capacity constraints shifting to CPO; MOCVD lead time stable ~12 months; CW lasers 80% of revenue. $AAOI not alone.
2126189347481538755.zh_summary: 與源傑半導體產業渠道檢查：因自身 CW 激光產能不足而未供應 Eoptolink（對商用激光玩家正面）；$AXTI InP 基板價格 2026 年 Q4 上漲數個百分點；住友約 80% 產能已被 InnoLight 鎖定；300-400mW 激光主要供應 $NVDA 的 NPO 架構，成為核心供應商，因 $LITE 產能受限轉向 CPO；MOCVD 交期穩定約 12 個月；CW 激光佔營收 80%。$AAOI 並非孤例。

2126187859996746235.en_summary: Remember this logic for $MU and other memory stocks from the bears: the lower the forward P/E, the more expensive the stock is, and vice versa, the higher the forward P/E, the cheaper the stock is.
2126187859996746235.zh_summary: 記住空頭對 $MU 及其他記憶體股的邏輯：遠期市盈率越低股票越貴，反之遠期市盈率越高股票越便宜。

2126187069160714637.en_summary: $HSBC layoffs confirmed: several hundred finance jobs in India centres being pulled into Chennai, Gurugram and Bengaluru; Hyderabad and Pune lose them. Move or leave, no extra cash to move.
2126187069160714637.zh_summary: $HSBC 裁員確認：印度中心數百個金融職位轉移至 Chennai、Gurugram 及 Bengaluru；Hyderabad 及 Pune 失去這些職位。搬走或離開，無額外現金補償。
